name: Medical Baseline Allowance
description: Extra low-cost energy allowance for customers with qualifying medical conditions requiring additional electricity or gas (including CPAP); also get extra alerts before Public Safety Power Shutoffs
fullDescription: The Medical Baseline Allowance program provides additional low-cost energy to customers with qualifying medical conditions that require extra electricity or gas, and includes priority notification before power shutoffs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Additional baseline energy at lowest tier rates
- PG&E customers get about 500 extra kWh of electricity and/or 25 extra therms of gas per month (some electric rate plans get a 12% discount instead)
- Extra advance alerts before Public Safety Power Shutoffs (PSPS)
- Free to enroll
- Eligibility for PG&E's free portable battery program
howToGetIt:
1. Have a medical practitioner certify your condition or equipment on the utility's application
2. Qualifying conditions include: life-support equipment, heating/cooling needs for medical conditions, CPAP/BiPAP, oxygen concentrator, motorized wheelchair, multiple sclerosis, and more
3. Submit the application to your utility provider (PG&E, SCE, SDG&E, etc.)
4. Recertify as required (PG&E: every 2 years, or self-certify every 4 years for permanent conditions)
5. Contact your utility immediately if medical equipment is affected by an outage
keywords: Medical Baseline, CPAP, BiPAP, oxygen, life support, electric wheelchair, PSPS notification, medical equipment, disability, low-cost energy
